aviation_incidents.headline: 菲律賓空軍兩架SF-260相撞墜毀造成4名飛行員殉職 國防部調查並停飛同型機
aviation_incidents.summary: 菲律賓空軍兩架SF-260教練機於2026年10月23日在八打雁省費爾南多空軍基地訓練時相撞墜毀，機上4名飛行員全數殉職，地面無其他人員傷亡。國防部已展開調查，檢視飛行計畫、訓練、維修及指揮等環節；空軍預防性停飛所有SF-260教練機。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Philippine Air Force SF-260 collision kills four pilots; fleet grounded as investigation begins
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Two Philippine Air Force SF-260 trainers collided and crashed during training at Fernando Air Base in Batangas on October 23, 2026, killing all four pilots on board; no other people on the ground were reported injured. The Department of National Defense has opened an investigation covering flight planning, training, maintenance and command, while the air force has grounded its SF-260 fleet as a precaution.

sources.name: AeroTime — Philippines probes fatal SF-260 midair collision that kille…

aviation_incidents.headline: 胡塞武裝稱以彈道飛彈攻擊利雅德機場 沙烏地表示已攔截
aviation_incidents.summary: 利雅德哈立德國王國際機場10月25日部分恢復營運後隔天，葉門胡塞武裝稱以彈道飛彈攻擊機場；沙烏地表示防空系統已摧毀飛彈，胡塞方面的攻擊說法尚未獲獨立查證。機場航班量仍遠低於正常水準，利雅德航空已暫時將客運業務轉往蓋西姆。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Houthis claim ballistic missile attack on Riyadh airport; Saudi Arabia says missile intercepted
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The Houthis said they attacked King Khalid International Airport with a ballistic missile the day after it partially reopened on October 25. Saudi Arabia said its air defences destroyed the missile; the Houthi claim had not been independently verified. Flight activity remains far below normal, and Riyadh Air has temporarily shifted passenger operations to Al Qassim.
entities: Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport

international_aviation.headline: 奇異拒為A350-1000開發發動機 勞斯萊斯成為A350全系列獨家供應商至2030年
international_aviation.summary: 奇異曾願為空中巴士A350-900供應發動機，但拒絕為與波音777競爭的A350-1000開發所需高推力發動機；勞斯萊斯因此成為A350全系列唯一發動機供應商。空中巴士於2021年將A350-900的獨家供應協議延長至2030年，A350-1000則自始由勞斯萊斯獨家供應。
international_aviation.headline_en: GE declined to develop an A350-1000 engine; Rolls-Royce remains the A350 family’s sole supplier through 2030
international_aviation.summary_en: GE was willing to supply an engine for the Airbus A350-900 but declined to develop the higher-thrust engine required for the A350-1000, which competes with the Boeing 777. Rolls-Royce consequently became the sole engine supplier for the A350 family. Airbus extended the A350-900 exclusivity agreement to 2030 in 2021; Rolls-Royce had supplied the A350-1000 exclusively from the outset.

international_aviation.headline: 漢莎航空退役最後一架A340-600 結束該機型逾二十年商業營運
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空於2026年10月18日正式退役最後一架空中巴士A340-600，結束該機型在旗下逾二十年的商業營運。同日發布的指南列出全球仍營運載客A340的航空公司與機場。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa retires its last A340-600, ending more than two decades of operations
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa officially retired its last Airbus A340-600 on October 18, 2026, ending more than two decades of commercial operation of the type with the airline. A guide published the same day listed airlines and airports worldwide that still operate passenger A340s.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Where To Spot The World's Last Passenger Airbus A340s

international_aviation.headline: 德國批准阿聯酋航空每週七班杜拜—柏林航權 航司計畫先以777-300ER執飛
international_aviation.summary: 德國於2026年9月批准阿聯酋航空經營杜拜至柏林每週最多七班直飛航班，柏林將成為該公司第五個德國客運航點；航權不含第五航權。阿聯酋航空計畫先以波音777-300ER執飛，待777-9準備就緒後再作安排。
international_aviation.headline_en: Germany approves Emirates’ Dubai–Berlin flights; airline plans initial 777-300ER service
international_aviation.summary_en: Germany approved Emirates’ Dubai–Berlin service in September 2026, allowing up to seven weekly flights. Berlin would become the airline’s fifth German passenger destination; the approval does not include fifth-freedom rights. Emirates plans to use Boeing 777-300ERs initially, until the 777-9 is ready.

international_aviation.headline: Frontier Airlines啟動客艙改裝 每架飛機增設八個頭等艙座位並預定三月初推出
international_aviation.summary: Frontier Airlines已開始改裝客艙，每架飛機將增設八個頭等艙座位，並配備電源插座與Starlink衛星網路。航空公司預定三月初推出新頭等艙產品。
international_aviation.headline_en: Frontier Airlines begins cabin retrofits with eight first-class seats per aircraft
international_aviation.summary_en: Frontier Airlines has begun cabin retrofits that will add eight first-class seats to each aircraft, equipped with power outlets and Starlink Wi-Fi. The airline has scheduled the launch of its new first-class product for early March.

international_aviation.headline: 波士頓羅根機場徵求濃厚波士頓口音廣播人選 八名決賽者角逐新聲音
international_aviation.summary: 波士頓羅根機場公開徵選擁有濃厚波士頓口音的人員，擔任機場新的廣播聲音。機場已公布八名決賽候選人，他們將角逐該職務。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boston Logan Airport seeks a strong local accent for announcements; eight finalists compete
international_aviation.summary_en: Boston Logan Airport is seeking a person with a strong Boston accent to become its new announcement voice. The airport has named eight finalists to compete for the role.

international_aviation.headline: 阿聯酋航空考慮開闢丹佛、底特律與費城直飛杜拜航線 航線仍待運能與機隊到位
international_aviation.summary: 阿聯酋航空總裁提姆·克拉克點名丹佛、底特律與費城為可能新增的杜拜直飛航點；三地目前都沒有直飛杜拜的航班。新航線能否開辦仍取決於運能恢復與機隊擴張，該公司預期首架波音777-9於2027年5月或6月交付。
international_aviation.headline_en: Emirates considers nonstop Dubai routes from Denver, Detroit and Philadelphia, subject to capacity
international_aviation.summary_en: Emirates president Tim Clark named Denver, Detroit and Philadelphia as possible new nonstop destinations from Dubai. None currently has a nonstop service to Dubai. Any launch depends on capacity recovery and fleet expansion; Emirates expects its first Boeing 777-9 delivery in May or June 2027.
